8 FREAKY tips to lose Fat faster 👇🏻 1️⃣ Eat protein first at every meal When you start with protein before carbs or fats, you stay fuller longer, reduce cravings later, and burn more calories digesting it compared to other foods. 2️⃣ Drink a full glass of water 15-20 minutes before meals Takes up space in your stomach so you naturally eat less. Most people are also mildly dehydrated, which your brain confuses for hunger. 3️⃣ Digestion walks are a cheat code A quick 5 minute walk after eating helps push carbs into your muscles instead of fat storage and keeps your blood sugar from spiking. Easy, free, no gym required. 4️⃣ Micro movements Tapping your foot, pacing on calls, taking the long route - these small movements burn more calories than you think and compound fast. 5️⃣ Sip hot water throughout the day Supports digestion and your body uses energy to bring it back to temperature. Small burn each time, but it adds up. 6️⃣ Use smaller plates and bowls Your brain judges fullness by how "done" your plate looks. A full small plate feels more satisfying than a half-empty big one, so you eat less without trying. 7️⃣ Sleep in a cold room (~65°F) Helps your body produce more brown fat overnight, which burns regular fat to keep you warm. You're literally burning extra calories while sleeping. 8️⃣ The 3-2-1 Rule Stop eating 3 hours before bed so your body can digest. Cut water 2 hours before bed so you're not up all night. Screens off 1 hour before bed so sleep quality doesn't tank. Better sleep = better fat loss. Follow for more fitness tips and daily content. #gymtok #gymmotivation #fitnesstips #fatloss #workout

1. Eating too little — Your body needs enough food and energy to function properly. 2. Expecting overnight results — Healthy progress takes time, so be patient with yourself. 3. Ignoring your daily steps — Using a walking app can help you track your steps, stay motivated and work towards your daily movement goals! (I use Fastwalk) 4. Not drinking enough water — Keep a water bottle nearby and drink regularly throughout the day. 5. Doing workouts you hate — Find activities you genuinely enjoy so it’s easier to stay consistent. 6. Comparing your progress to others — Everyone’s body and journey are different, so focus on yourself. 7. Being too hard on yourself — Remember, consistency matters more than perfection. Give yourself grace! 💗 #gymtok #weightlosstips #glowuptips #motivation
